subproblems.title: Blow-ups preserve Radon convergence for tests supported in the blown-up domain (steps 0(a)–(b); printed 'η_{ξ,λ#}V_i → η_{ξ,λ#}V for each fixed λ')
subproblems.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, and V_i (i ∈ ℕ), V n-varifolds on U (so U is open) with V_i → V as Radon measures on G_n(U) (Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V: ∫ f d(V_i.domainMeasure) → ∫ f d(V.domainMeasure) for every f ∈ C_c(U × G(N,n))). Let ξ ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0 and F ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) such that ξ + t·y ∈ U for every (y, S) ∈ tsupport F. Then ∫ F d(V_i)_{ξ,t} → ∫ F dV_{ξ,t} as i → ∞, where V'_{ξ,t} := rescaledMeasure V' ξ t = ofReal(t^{-n})·(V'.measure)_#[(z, S) ↦ (t^{-1}(z − ξ), S)].
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ z, F z ∂(rescaledMeasure (Vi i) ξ t)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, F z ∂(rescaledMeasure V ξ t)))
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: steps 0(a)–0(b) of the parent proof; this is the parenthetical remark in the printed proof of Simon 8.5.9 "because V_i → V, and hence η_{ξ,λ#}V_i → η_{ξ,λ#}V for each fixed λ > 0". Notation: G := Grassmannian N n, Z := ℝ^N × G; for a varifold V' on U, V'_{ξ,t} := rescaledMeasure V' ξ t = ofReal(t⁻¹^n) • (V'.measure).map Φ, where Φ(z) := (t⁻¹ • (z.1 − ξ), z.2).

1. (Φ is a homeomorphism.) Put Ψ(z) := (ξ + t • z.1, z.2). Φ and Ψ are continuous, and Ψ ∘ Φ = id, Φ ∘ Ψ = id because t ≠ 0 (t⁻¹ • t = 1). Hence Φ is a homeomorphism of Z; in particular Φ is Borel measurable and is a cocompact map (Homeomorph.toCocompactMap).

2. (Pulled-back test function.) Let H := F ∘ Φ. Composition of a compactly supported continuous function with a cocompact map is compactly supported (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.comp F Φ.toCocompactMap), so H ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ). Since Φ is continuous, tsupport H ⊆ Φ⁻¹(tsupport F) (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage). If z ∈ tsupport H then Φ z ∈ tsupport F, and the hypothesis applied to Φ z gives ξ + t • (t⁻¹ • (z.1 − ξ)) = z.1 ∈ U. Hence tsupport H ⊆ U ×ˢ univ, and tsupport H is compact.

3. (Rescaling formula.) For every varifold V' on U: ∫ F dV'_{ξ,t} = t⁻¹^n · ∫ H dV'.measure. Indeed ∫ F d(c • μ) = c.toReal · ∫ F dμ for every c ∈ [0,∞] (integral_smul_measure), (ofReal(t⁻¹^n)).toReal = t⁻¹^n because t⁻¹^n ≥ 0 (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal), and ∫ F d(μ.map Φ) = ∫ F(Φ z) dμ(z) (integral_map; Φ is measurable and F is continuous, hence a.e. strongly measurable). No integrability is needed for these identities.

4. (Restriction to Simon's open product.) Let Ω := U ×ˢ (univ : Set G). U is open (V.isOpen_domain), so Ω is open and measurable; let ι : Ω → Z be the inclusion and h := H ∘ ι : Ω → ℝ. h is continuous. Its support is contained in ι⁻¹(tsupport H), which is closed in Ω, so tsupport h ⊆ ι⁻¹(tsupport H) (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage); and ι⁻¹(tsupport H) is compact, because tsupport H is compact and contained in range ι = Ω (step 2) and ι is an embedding (Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.isCompact_preimage'). Hence h has compact support, i.e. h ∈ C_c(Ω, ℝ). (This is the construction of SimonGMT Varifold.divergenceDomainTest.)

5. (Domain integrals.) For every varifold V' on U: ∫ h d(V'.domainMeasure) = ∫ H dV'.measure. Indeed V'.measure = (V'.domainMeasure).map ι (Varifold.map_domainMeasure), and ι is a measurable embedding (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe for the measurable set Ω), so ∫ H d((V'.domainMeasure).map ι) = ∫ H(ι w) d(V'.domainMeasure)(w) (MeasurableEmbedding.integral_map). (Compare Varifold.integral_divergenceDomainTest.)

6. (Conclusion.) By the definition of Varifold.RadonConverges applied to h ∈ C_c(Ω, ℝ), ∫ h d((Vi i).domainMeasure) → ∫ h d(V.domainMeasure) as i → ∞. Multiplying by the constant t⁻¹^n (Tendsto.const_mul) and rewriting both sides with step 5 and then step 3 (for V' = Vi i and for V' = V) gives ∫ F d(Vi i)_{ξ,t} → ∫ F dV_{ξ,t}. ∎

subproblems.title: Compactly supported tests supported in the blown-up domain are integrable for the blow-up
subproblems.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U, ξ ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0 and F ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with ξ + t·y ∈ U for every (y, S) ∈ tsupport F. Then F is integrable with respect to V_{ξ,t} = rescaledMeasure V ξ t = ofReal(t^{-n})·(V.measure)_#[(z, S) ↦ (t^{-1}(z − ξ), S)].
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ) (F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), 0 < t → (∀ z ∈ tsupport F, ξ + t • z.1 ∈ U) → Integrable (fun z ↦ F z) (rescaledMeasure V ξ t)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: the integrability of the cut-off test functions that the parent proof integrates against blow-ups in steps 0(d), 3(vii) and 7 (needed to turn convergent test integrals into mass bounds). Notation: G := Grassmannian N n, Z := ℝ^N × G, Φ(z) := (t⁻¹ • (z.1 − ξ), z.2), so that V_{ξ,t} := rescaledMeasure V ξ t = ofReal(t⁻¹^n) • (V.measure).map Φ.

1. (Pulled-back test function.) Φ is a homeomorphism of Z with inverse Ψ(z) := (ξ + t • z.1, z.2) (t ≠ 0); in particular Φ is continuous, measurable and cocompact. Let H := F ∘ Φ ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ) (CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.comp F Φ.toCocompactMap). Then tsupport H ⊆ Φ⁻¹(tsupport F) (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage), and for z ∈ tsupport H the hypothesis applied to Φ z ∈ tsupport F gives z.1 = ξ + t • (t⁻¹ • (z.1 − ξ)) ∈ U. So tsupport H ⊆ U ×ˢ univ.

2. (A compact base.) Let K := Prod.fst '' tsupport H ⊆ ℝ^N. K is compact (continuous image of the compact set tsupport H), K ⊆ U by step 1, and support H ⊆ tsupport H ⊆ K ×ˢ univ. By V.finite_on_compact, V.measure (K ×ˢ univ) ≠ ∞.

3. (H is V-integrable.) H is continuous with compact support, hence bounded: |H z| ≤ M for all z (HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous); it is continuous, hence a.e. strongly measurable. Thus H is integrable on K ×ˢ univ (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded, using step 2), and because support H ⊆ K ×ˢ univ, H is integrable on Z with respect to V.measure (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset).

4. (Transfer to the blow-up.) F is continuous, hence a.e. strongly measurable for (V.measure).map Φ, and Φ is measurable; so F is integrable for (V.measure).map Φ if and only if F ∘ Φ = H is integrable for V.measure (integrable_map_measure), which holds by step 3. Finally V_{ξ,t} = c • (V.measure).map Φ with c := ofReal(t⁻¹^n) ≠ ∞, so F is integrable for V_{ξ,t} (Integrable.smul_measure). ∎

subproblems.title: A countable sup-dense family in C_c(ℝ^N × G) with supports in B°_R(0) × G (step 1)
subproblems.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and R > 0. There are g_m ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) (m ∈ ℕ) with tsupport g_m ⊆ B°_R(0) × G(N,n) for every m such that for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with tsupport f ⊆ B°_R(0) × G(N,n) and every η > 0 there is m with |f(z) − g_m(z)| ≤ η for all z ∈ ℝ^N × G(N,n).
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∃ g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 1 of the parent proof (a countable dense family in 𝓕 := {f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G) : tsupport f ⊆ B°_R(0) × G}). The parent offered Stone–Weierstrass "for instance"; here the same claim is proved by separability of C(Z, ℝ) and Urysohn cut-offs, exactly as in the accepted DAG lemma Submission.radon_compactlySupported_countable_approx (commit 2721e20337252ca8e1f6204843570bd04ba673c8), with its compact exhaustion of X replaced by an exhaustion of the ball. Notation: G := Grassmannian N n (compact, metrizable, second countable: SimonGMT Grassmannian.instCompactSpace / instSecondCountableTopology), Z := ℝ^N × G (locally compact, Hausdorff, second countable), C(Z, ℝ) with the compact-open topology.

1. (C(Z, ℝ) is second countable.) Let 𝓑 be a countable basis of Z, 𝓢 := {closure B : B ∈ 𝓑, closure B compact} (a countable family of compact sets) and 𝓣 a countable basis of ℝ. For K ∈ 𝓢 and a finite t ⊆ 𝓣 let [K, t] := {f ∈ C(Z, ℝ) : f(K) ⊆ ⋃t}; these sets form a countable family 𝓖 (𝓢 is countable and the finite subsets of the countable set 𝓣 form a countable set). Claim: the compact-open topology equals the topology generated by 𝓖. (i) Each [K, t] is compact-open open, since K is compact and ⋃t is open. (ii) Conversely let f ∈ C(Z, ℝ), K ⊆ Z compact, U ⊆ ℝ open with f(K) ⊆ U. Writing U as a union of members of 𝓣 and using compactness of f(K), choose a finite t ⊆ 𝓣 with f(K) ⊆ ⋃t and every V ∈ t contained in U. For x ∈ K pick V ∈ t with f(x) ∈ V; f⁻¹(V) is an open neighbourhood of x, so by local compactness it contains a compact neighbourhood C of x, and there is B ∈ 𝓑 with x ∈ B ⊆ C; then L_x := closure B ⊆ C is compact, so L_x ∈ 𝓢, L_x is a neighbourhood of x, and f(L_x) ⊆ V ⊆ ⋃t. Finitely many L_{x_1}, …, L_{x_p} cover K (compactness of K), f ∈ ⋂_j [L_{x_j}, t], and every g in this finite intersection satisfies g(K) ⊆ ⋃_j g(L_{x_j}) ⊆ ⋃t ⊆ U. Hence every compact-open neighbourhood of f contains a 𝓖-neighbourhood of f, and the two topologies coincide; so C(Z, ℝ) is second countable. (This is Mathlib's ContinuousMap.compactOpen_eq_generateFrom / ContinuousMap.instSecondCountableTopology from Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.SecondCountableSpace, which the frozen contract does not import; it must be inlined, as in the accepted lemma cited above.)

2. (Dense sequence; uniform approximation on compacts.) By 1, C(Z, ℝ) is separable; let d : ℕ → C(Z, ℝ) have dense range (TopologicalSpace.denseSeq). The compact-open topology of C(Z, ℝ) is the topology of the uniformity of uniform convergence on compact sets (ContinuousMap.hasBasis_compactConvergenceUniformity). Hence for every h ∈ C(Z, ℝ), compact L ⊆ Z and η > 0, {g : |h(z) − g(z)| < η for all z ∈ L} is a neighbourhood of h and so contains some d_i: there is i with |h(z) − d_i(z)| < η for all z ∈ L.

3. (Exhaustion of the ball and cut-offs.) For m ∈ ℕ let r_m := R·(m+1)/(m+2). Then 0 < r_m < R, r_m < r_{m+1}, and r_m → R. Let E_m := closedBall(0, r_m) ×ˢ univ ⊆ Z (compact). E_m and the closed set (ball(0, r_{m+1}) ×ˢ univ)ᶜ are disjoint (closedBall(0, r_m) ⊆ ball(0, r_{m+1})), so Urysohn's lemma for locally compact Hausdorff spaces (exists_continuous_one_zero_of_isCompact) gives χ_m ∈ C(Z, ℝ) with χ_m = 1 on E_m, χ_m = 0 off ball(0, r_{m+1}) × G, χ_m(z) ∈ [0, 1] for all z, and χ_m with compact support. Since support χ_m ⊆ ball(0, r_{m+1}) × G, tsupport χ_m ⊆ closedBall(0, r_{m+1}) × G ⊆ B°_R(0) × G (r_{m+1} < R).

4. (The family.) For k ∈ ℕ let (m, i) := Nat.unpair k and g_k := χ_m · d_i. It is continuous with compact support (HasCompactSupport.mul_right), so g_k ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ), and tsupport g_k ⊆ tsupport χ_m ⊆ B°_R(0) × G (tsupport_mul_subset_left). This is the first assertion.

5. (Approximation.) Let f ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ) with tsupport f ⊆ B°_R(0) × G and η > 0.
(a) There is m with tsupport f ⊆ E_m: the open sets ball(0, r_m) × G increase with m and cover B°_R(0) × G (if |y| < R, then |y| < r_m for large m since r_m → R), hence cover the compact set tsupport f, so a single one of them contains it (IsCompact.elim_directed_cover for a monotone family); and ball(0, r_m) × G ⊆ E_m.
(b) By step 2 with h := f and L := E_{m+1}, choose i with |f(z) − d_i(z)| < η for all z ∈ E_{m+1}, and put k := Nat.pair m i, so g_k = χ_m · d_i.
(c) f = χ_m · f on Z: on E_m, χ_m = 1; off E_m, z ∉ tsupport f, so f(z) = 0. Hence f − g_k = χ_m · (f − d_i) and |f(z) − g_k(z)| = χ_m(z)·|f(z) − d_i(z)|. If z ∈ E_{m+1} this is ≤ 1·η. subproblems.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U with locally bounded first variation, ξ ∈ ℝ^N, t > 0 and R > 0 with ξ + t·y ∈ U for every y ∈ B°_R(0). Then there is an n-varifold W on B°_R(0) such that W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (B°_R(0) × G(N,n)) (i.e. W = V_{ξ,t} ⌞ G_n(B°_R(0))), W has locally bounded first variation, and variationMeasure W (B°_R(0)) ≤ ofReal(t^{-n}·t)·variationMeasure V (B_{tR}(ξ)), where B_ρ(x) is the closed ball and variationMeasure is ‖δ·‖.

Source: steps 4 and 6 of the parent proof, i.e. Simon 8.5.9 printed (4) ("(by (2)) ‖δW_i‖(B_R(0)) → 0"), for one blow-up; the Riesz and polar-representation facts are SimonGMT Varifold.firstVariationRieszMeasure_eq_norm and Varifold.isFirstVariationPolarRepresentation_riesz. Notation: G := Grassmannian N n; O := B°_R(0) = ball 0 R; σ(y) := ξ + t • y and η(z) := t⁻¹ • (z − ξ), mutually inverse homeomorphisms of ℝ^N (t ≠ 0); Φ(z, S) := (η z, S); V_{ξ,t} := rescaledMeasure V ξ t = ofReal(t⁻¹^n) • (V.measure).map Φ; c_t := t⁻¹^n · t ≥ 0; hV : V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation. By hypothesis σ(O) ⊆ U, and σ(O) ⊆ closedBall ξ (t·R) because |σ(y) − ξ| = t|y|.

1. (The varifold W.) Let m := V_{ξ,t}.restrict (O ×ˢ univ). (a) O is open. (b) m(Oᶜ ×ˢ univ) = V_{ξ,t}((Oᶜ ×ˢ univ) ∩ (O ×ˢ univ)) = V_{ξ,t}(∅) = 0 (Measure.restrict_apply; Oᶜ ×ˢ univ is measurable). (c) Let K ⊆ O be compact. m(K ×ˢ univ) ≤ V_{ξ,t}(K ×ˢ univ) = ofReal(t⁻¹^n) · V.measure(Φ⁻¹(K ×ˢ univ)) (Measure.restrict_apply_le, Measure.map_apply with Φ measurable) and Φ⁻¹(K ×ˢ univ) = η⁻¹(K) ×ˢ univ = σ(K) ×ˢ univ. σ(K) is compact and σ(K) ⊆ σ(O) ⊆ U, so V.measure(σ(K) ×ˢ univ) ≠ ∞ (V.finite_on_compact) and m(K ×ˢ univ) ≠ ∞. Hence W := ⟨isOpen_ball, m, (b), (c)⟩ is an n-varifold on O with W.measure = V_{ξ,t}.restrict (O ×ˢ univ): the first assertion.

2. (Integrals against W.) If h : ℝ^N × G → ℝ is continuous and h = 0 off O ×ˢ univ, then ∫ h dW.measure = ∫ h dV_{ξ,t} (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero) = t⁻¹^n · ∫ h(Φ z) dV.measure(z) (integral_smul_measure with (ofReal(t⁻¹^n)).toReal = t⁻¹^n, and integral_map; Φ measurable, h continuous).

3. (Pulled-back test fields.) Let X be a test field on O (Varifold.TestVectorField O: C¹, compact support, tsupport X ⊆ O) and Y := X ∘ η, Y(z) = X(t⁻¹ • (z − ξ)). (a) Y is C¹ (ContDiff.comp with the affine map η). (b) tsupport Y ⊆ η⁻¹(tsupport X) = σ(tsupport X) (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage; σ = η⁻¹ as homeomorphisms); σ(tsupport X) is compact, so Y has compact support, and σ(tsupport X) ⊆ σ(O) ⊆ U. Hence Y is a test field on U. (c) ‖Y z‖ = ‖X(η z)‖, so if ‖X‖ ≤ 1 everywhere then ‖Y‖ ≤ 1 everywhere; if tsupport X ⊆ O' then tsupport Y ⊆ σ(O'). So X.UnitSupportedIn O' implies Y.UnitSupportedIn σ(O'), where σ(O') = (fun y ↦ ξ + t • y) '' O'. (d) By the chain rule (fderiv_comp) and fderiv η z = t⁻¹ • id, fderiv Y z = t⁻¹ • fderiv X (η z); as clmToMatrix is linear, jacobian Y z = t⁻¹ • jacobian X (η z), hence for every S ∈ G: tangentialDivergence Y z S = trace(S.1 * jacobian Y z) = t⁻¹ · tangentialDivergence X (η z) S.

4. (First-variation scaling, printed (4).) For X, Y as in 3, h(y, S) := tangentialDivergence X y S is continuous (Varifold.continuous_tangentialDivergence) and vanishes off tsupport X ×ˢ univ ⊆ O ×ˢ univ (Varifold.support_tangentialDivergence_subset). By 2 and 3(d): δW(X) = ∫ h dW.measure = t⁻¹^n · ∫ tangentialDivergence X (η z) S dV(z, S) = t⁻¹^n · ∫ t · tangentialDivergence Y z S dV(z, S) = t⁻¹^n · t · δV(Y) = c_t · δV(Y) (integral_const_mul).

5. (Comparison of first-variation norms.) For every set O' ⊆ ℝ^N: firstVariationNormOn W O' ≤ ofReal(c_t) · firstVariationNormOn V (σ(O')). Indeed firstVariationNormOn W O' is the supremum over test fields X on O of [ofReal|δW(X)| if X.UnitSupportedIn O', else 0]. The terms 0 are trivially bounded. If X.UnitSupportedIn O', then Y from 3 satisfies Y.UnitSupportedIn σ(O') (3c), so ofReal|δV(Y)| ≤ firstVariationNormOn V (σ(O')) (Varifold.le_firstVariationNormOn), and by 4, ofReal|δW(X)| = ofReal(c_t·|δV(Y)|) = ofReal(c_t)·ofReal|δV(Y)| (ENNReal.ofReal_mul, c_t ≥ 0) ≤ ofReal(c_t)·firstVariationNormOn V (σ(O')). Take the supremum (iSup_le).

6. (W has locally bounded first variation.) Let O' be open with closure O' compact and closure O' ⊆ O. Since σ is a homeomorphism, σ(O') is open and closure σ(O') = σ(closure O'), which is compact and contained in σ(O) ⊆ U. By hV, firstVariationNormOn V (σ(O')) ≠ ∞, so by 5 firstVariationNormOn W O' ≤ ofReal(c_t) · firstVariationNormOn V (σ(O')) ≠ ∞. This proves W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation (hW): the second assertion.

7. (‖δV‖ dominates the norm.) By definition of variationMeasure (dif_pos hV), variationMeasure V = V.firstVariationRieszMeasure hV, and Varifold.firstVariationNormOn_le_of_polarRepresentation applied to Varifold.isFirstVariationPolarRepresentation_riesz V hV gives firstVariationNormOn V A ≤ variationMeasure V A for every set A.

8. (‖δW‖ on all of O.) By 6, variationMeasure W = W.firstVariationRieszMeasure hW. For j ∈ ℕ let R_j := R·(j+1)/(j+2) (so 0 < R_j < R, R_j increasing, R_j → R) and O_j := ball 0 R_j. O_j is open and closure O_j = closedBall 0 R_j (R_j ≠ 0) is compact and contained in O, so Varifold.firstVariationRieszMeasure_eq_norm gives variationMeasure W O_j = firstVariationNormOn W O_j. By 5 and 7 and σ(O_j) ⊆ σ(O) ⊆ closedBall ξ (t·R): variationMeasure W O_j ≤ ofReal(c_t)·firstVariationNormOn V (σ(O_j)) ≤ ofReal(c_t)·variationMeasure V (σ(O_j)) ≤ ofReal(c_t)·variationMeasure V (closedBall ξ (t·R)). The O_j increase and ⋃_j O_j = O (for |y| < R choose j with R_j > |y|), so by continuity from below (Monotone.measure_iUnion) variationMeasure W O = ⨆_j variationMeasure W O_j ≤ ofReal(t⁻¹^n · t)·variationMeasure V (closedBall ξ (t·R)): the third assertion. ∎

theorem Submission.intcpt_diag_blowup_variation_bound : ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (ξ : Euclidean N) (t R : ℝ), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → 0 < t → 0 < R → (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R, ξ + t • y ∈ U) → ∃ W : Varifold N n (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R), W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ∧ W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation ∧ variationMeasure W (ball (0 : Euclidean N) R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n * t) * variationMeasure V (closedBall ξ (t * R)) := by
  intro N n U V ξ t R hV ht hR hσU
  set O : Set (Euclidean N) := ball (0 : Euclidean N) R with hOdef
  have hOm : MeasurableSet O := measurableSet_ball
  -- the homeomorphism σ(y) = ξ + t • y, with inverse η(z) = t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)
  let σ : Euclidean N ≃ₜ Euclidean N :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ ξ + t • y
      invFun := fun z ↦ t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)
      left_inv := by intro y; simp [smul_smul, ht.ne']
      right_inv := by intro z; simp [smul_smul, ht.ne']
      continuous_toFun := by fun_prop
      continuous_invFun := by fun_prop }
  have hσ : ∀ y, σ y = ξ + t • y := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hσs : ∀ z, σ.symm z = t⁻¹ • (z - ξ) := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hσO : σ '' O ⊆ U := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hσU y hy
  have hσball : σ '' O ⊆ closedBall ξ (t * R) := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [hσ, mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht]
    rw [hOdef, mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hy
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.le ht.le
  have hΦc : Continuous (fun z : Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n ↦ (t⁻¹ • (z.1 - ξ), z.2)) := by
    fun_prop
  -- Step 1: the varifold W
  let W : Varifold N n O :=
    { isOpen_domain := isOpen_ball
      measure := (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))
      supported := by
        rw [Measure.restrict_apply (hOm.compl.prod MeasurableSet.univ)]
        have : (Oᶜ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ∩ (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) = ∅ := by
          ext z; simp
        rw [this, measure_empty]
      finite_on_compact := by
        intro K hK hKO
        apply ne_top_of_le_ne_top _ (Measure.restrict_apply_le _ _)
        rw [rescaledMeasure, Measure.smul_apply,
          Measure.map_apply hΦc.measurable (hK.measurableSet.prod MeasurableSet.univ), smul_eq_mul]
        apply ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
        have he : (fun z : Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n ↦ (t⁻¹ • (z.1 - ξ), z.2)) ⁻¹'
            (K ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) = (σ '' K) ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) := by
          ext z
          simp only [mem_preimage, mem_prod, mem_univ, and_true]
          rw [σ.image_eq_preimage_symm]
          rfl
        rw [he]
        exact V.finite_on_compact _ (hK.image σ.continuous) ((image_mono hKO).trans hσO) }
  have hWmeas : W.measure = (rescaledMeasure V ξ t).restrict (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) := rfl
  refine ⟨W, rfl, ?_⟩
  -- Step 3: pulled-back test fields and the first-variation scaling (Step 4)
  have hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : Euclidean N ↦ t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) := by fun_prop
  have hfd : ∀ z : Euclidean N, fderiv ℝ (fun z : Euclidean N ↦ t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) z =
      t⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclidean N) :=
    fun z ↦ (((hasFDerivAt_id z).sub_const ξ).const_smul t⁻¹).fderiv
  have hpull : ∀ X : Varifold.TestVectorField (N := N) O, ∃ Y : Varifold.TestVectorField (N := N) U,
      (∀ z, Y z = X (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ))) ∧ tsupport Y.toFun ⊆ σ '' tsupport X.toFun ∧
      W.firstVariation X = t⁻¹ ^ n * t * V.firstVariation Y := by
    intro X
    let Yf : Euclidean N → Euclidean N := fun z ↦ X (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ))
    have hYsupp : tsupport Yf ⊆ σ '' tsupport X.toFun := by
      rw [σ.image_eq_preimage_symm]
      exact tsupport_comp_subset_preimage X.toFun σ.symm.continuous
    let Y : Varifold.TestVectorField (N := N) U :=
      { toFun := Yf
        contDiff := X.contDiff.comp hη
        compactSupport :=
          (X.compactSupport.isCompact.image σ.continuous).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _)
            hYsupp
        support_subset := hYsupp.trans ((image_mono X.support_subset).trans hσO) }
    refine ⟨Y, fun z ↦ rfl, hYsupp, ?_⟩
    have hdiv : ∀ z (S : Grassmannian N n), Varifold.tangentialDivergence Y z S =
        t⁻¹ * Varifold.tangentialDivergence X (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) S := by
      intro z S
      have hX' : DifferentiableAt ℝ X.toFun (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) :=
        (X.contDiff.differentiable one_ne_zero) _
      have hcomp : fderiv ℝ Yf z = t⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ X.toFun (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) := by
        have h1 : fderiv ℝ (X.toFun ∘ fun z ↦ t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) z =
            (fderiv ℝ X.toFun (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ))).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun z ↦ t⁻¹ • (z - ξ)) z) :=

        rw [show Yf = X.toFun ∘ fun z ↦ t⁻¹ • (z - ξ) from rfl, h1, hfd]
        ext v
        simp
      change Matrix.trace (S.1 * Varifold.clmToMatrix (fderiv ℝ Yf z)) =
        t⁻¹ * Matrix.trace (S.1 * Varifold.clmToMatrix (fderiv ℝ X.toFun (t⁻¹ • (z - ξ))))
      rw [hcomp, map_smul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.trace_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdivX_cont := Varifold.continuous_tangentialDivergence (n := n) X.contDiff
    have hvanish : ∀ z ∉ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)),
        Varifold.tangentialDivergence X.toFun z.1 z.2 = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra hne
      exact hz (prod_mono X.support_subset subset_rfl
        (Varifold.support_tangentialDivergence_subset X.toFun hne))
    calc W.firstVariation X = ∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X.toFun z.1 z.2 ∂W.measure := rfl
      _ = ∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X.toFun z.1 z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V ξ t) := by
          rw [hWmeas]; exact setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hvanish
      _ = t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X.toFun (t⁻¹ • (z.1 - ξ)) z.2 ∂V.measure := by
          rw [rescaledMeasure, integral_smul_measure,
            integral_map hΦc.measurable.aemeasurable hdivX_cont.aestronglyMeasurable,
            ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), smul_eq_mul]
      _ = t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z, t * Varifold.tangentialDivergence Y z.1 z.2 ∂V.measure := by
          congr 1
          apply integral_congr_ae
          filter_upwards with z
          rw [hdiv]
          field_simp
      _ = t⁻¹ ^ n * t * V.firstVariation Y := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, mul_assoc]
          rfl

  have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t⁻¹ ^ n * t := by positivity
  have hcmp : ∀ O' : Set (Euclidean N), W.firstVariationNormOn O' ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n * t) * V.firstVariationNormOn (σ '' O') := by
    intro O'
    classical
    generalize hB : V.firstVariationNormOn (σ '' O') = B
    unfold Varifold.firstVariationNormOn
    refine iSup_le fun X ↦ ?_
    split_ifs with hX
    · obtain ⟨Y, hYz, hYsupp, hδ⟩ := hpull X
      have hY : Y.UnitSupportedIn (σ '' O') := by
        refine ⟨hYsupp.trans (image_mono hX.1), fun z ↦ ?_⟩
        rw [hYz]
        exact hX.2 _
      have hle := Varifold.le_firstVariationNormOn V (σ '' O') Y hY
      rw [hB] at hle
      rw [hδ, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc0]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle zero_le
    · exact zero_le
  -- Step 6: W has locally bounded first variation
  have hW : W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation := by
    intro O' hO' hO'c
    have hσO' : IsOpen (σ '' O') := σ.isOpenMap _ hO'
    have hcl : closure (σ '' O') = σ '' closure O' := (σ.image_closure O').symm
    have hfin := hV (σ '' O') hσO'
      ⟨by rw [hcl]; exact hO'c.1.image σ.continuous,
       by rw [hcl]; exact (image_mono hO'c.2).trans hσO⟩
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hfin) (hcmp O')
  refine ⟨hW, ?_⟩
  -- Steps 7-8: the Riesz measures and the exhaustion of O
  have hvW : variationMeasure W = W.firstVariationRieszMeasure hW := by
    simp [variationMeasure, hW]
  have hvV : variationMeasure V = V.firstVariationRieszMeasure hV := by
    simp [variationMeasure, hV]
  have hpolar : ∀ A, V.firstVariationNormOn A ≤ variationMeasure V A := by
    intro A
    rw [hvV]
    exact V.firstVariationNormOn_le_of_polarRepresentation
      (V.isFirstVariationPolarRepresentation_riesz hV) A
  set r : ℕ → ℝ := fun j ↦ R * (((j : ℝ) + 1) / ((j : ℝ) + 2)) with hr
  have hrpos : ∀ j, 0 < r j := fun j ↦ by positivity
  have hrlt : ∀ j, r j < R := by
    intro j
    have : ((j : ℝ) + 1) / ((j : ℝ) + 2) < 1 := by rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]; linarith
    calc r j = R * (((j : ℝ) + 1) / ((j : ℝ) + 2)) := rfl
      _ < R * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this hR
      _ = R := mul_one R
  have hrmono : Monotone r := by
    apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
    intro j
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hR.le
    push_cast
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hrlim : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 R) := by
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ ↦ ((m : ℝ) + 1) / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
      have := tendsto_natCast_div_add_atTop (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : ℝ)
      have h2 : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ ↦ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((m + 1 : ℕ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 1) :=
        this.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
      refine h2.congr (fun m ↦ ?_)
      push_cast
      ring_nf
    simpa using h1.const_mul R
  have hunion : O = ⋃ j, ball (0 : Euclidean N) (r j) := by
    ext y
    simp only [hOdef, mem_iUnion, mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    constructor
    · intro hy
      exact (hrlim.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hy)).exists
    · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      exact hj.trans (hrlt j)
  have hmono : Monotone (fun j ↦ ball (0 : Euclidean N) (r j)) :=
    fun a b hab ↦ ball_subset_ball (hrmono hab)
  have hOj : ∀ j, variationMeasure W (ball (0 : Euclidean N) (r j)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (t⁻¹ ^ n * t) * variationMeasure V (closedBall ξ (t * R)) := by
    intro j
    have hclj : closure (ball (0 : Euclidean N) (r j)) = closedBall 0 (r j) :=
      closure_ball _ (hrpos j).ne'
    rw [hvW, Varifold.firstVariationRieszMeasure_eq_norm W hW _ isOpen_ball
      ⟨by rw [hclj]; exact isCompact_closedBall _ _,
       by rw [hclj]; exact closedBall_subset_ball (hrlt j)⟩]
    refine (hcmp _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hpolar _).trans (measure_mono ?_)) zero_le)
    exact (image_mono (ball_subset_ball (hrlt j).le)).trans hσball
  calc variationMeasure W O = variationMeasure W (⋃ j, ball (0 : Euclidean N) (r j)) :=
        congrArg _ hunion
    _ = ⨆ j, variationMeasure W (ball (0 : Euclidean N) (r j)) := hmono.measure_iUnion
    _ ≤ _ := iSup_le hOj

For a test field X on B°_R(0), Y := X(t⁻¹(· − ξ)) is a test field on U with tsupport Y ⊆ σ(tsupport X) and div_S Y(z) = t⁻¹ div_S X(t⁻¹(z − ξ)).

subproblems.title: Convergence on a dense family plus uniform mass bounds gives convergence on all tests supported in O × G (step 7)
subproblems.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^N measurable, A := O × G(N,n), and g_m ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) (m ∈ ℕ) with tsupport g_m ⊆ A such that for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with tsupport f ⊆ A and every η > 0 there is m with |f − g_m| ≤ η everywhere. Let μ_k, ν_k (k ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^N × G(N,n) and C ∈ [0,∞) such that μ_k(A) ≤ C and ν_k(A) ≤ C for all sufficiently large k and ∫ g_m dμ_k − ∫ g_m dν_k → 0 for every m. Then ∫ f dμ_k − ∫ f dν_k → 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N × G(N,n)) with tsupport f ⊆ A.
subproblems.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (μ ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (C : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet O → C ≠ ∞ → (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, μ k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ν k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ m, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, g m z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, g m z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, f z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)
subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: step 7 of the parent proof (extension of the convergence from the countable family {f_m} to every admissible f by a uniform mass bound), stated for two sequences of measures. Notation: Z := ℝ^N × G, A := O ×ˢ univ (measurable since O is), C₀ := C.toReal ≥ 0 (C ≠ ∞).

1. (Integrability.) Let μ' be a measure on Z with μ'(A) ≤ C and h ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ) with tsupport h ⊆ A. h is continuous with compact support, hence bounded (|h| ≤ M: HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous) and a.e. strongly measurable; μ'(A) ≤ C < ∞, so h is integrable on A (Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded), and since support h ⊆ tsupport h ⊆ A, h is μ'-integrable (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset).

2. (Basic estimate.) Let μ' satisfy μ'(A) ≤ C, η ≥ 0 and h : Z → ℝ with h(z) = 0 for z ∉ A and |h(z)| ≤ η for all z. Then ∫ h dμ' = ∫_A h dμ' (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero) and |∫_A h dμ'| ≤ η · μ'.real(A) (norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const, μ'(A) < ∞) ≤ η · C₀ (ENNReal.toReal_mono).

3. Fix f ∈ C_c(Z, ℝ) with tsupport f ⊆ A, and ε > 0. Put η := ε / (4(C₀ + 1)) > 0 and choose m with |f(z) − g_m(z)| ≤ η for all z (density hypothesis). The function h := f − g_m satisfies |h| ≤ η and h(z) = 0 for z ∉ A (f(z) = 0 because z ∉ tsupport f, and g_m(z) = 0 because z ∉ tsupport g_m ⊆ A).

4. By hypothesis, for all sufficiently large k (finitely many eventual statements): μ_k(A) ≤ C, ν_k(A) ≤ C, and |∫ g_m dμ_k − ∫ g_m dν_k| < ε/2 (the latter from ∫ g_m dμ_k − ∫ g_m dν_k → 0). Fix such k. By 1, f and g_m are integrable for μ_k and for ν_k, so ∫ f dμ_k − ∫ g_m dμ_k = ∫ h dμ_k and ∫ f dν_k − ∫ g_m dν_k = ∫ h dν_k (integral_sub), and by 2 both have absolute value ≤ ηC₀.

5. Hence |∫ f dμ_k − ∫ f dν_k| ≤ |∫ h dμ_k| + |∫ g_m dμ_k − ∫ g_m dν_k| + |∫ h dν_k| < 2ηC₀ + ε/2 ≤ ε, since 2ηC₀ = (ε/2)·C₀/(C₀+1) < ε/2. As ε > 0 was arbitrary, ∫ f dμ_k − ∫ f dν_k → 0 (Metric.tendsto_atTop). ∎

theorem Submission.intcpt_diag_dense_family_tendsto : ∀ (N n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : ℕ → C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (μ ν : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (C : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet O → C ≠ ∞ → (∀ m, tsupport (g m) ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ m, ∀ z, |f z - g m z| ≤ η) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, μ k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ν k (O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ C) → (∀ m, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, g m z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, g m z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ f : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), tsupport f ⊆ O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ z, f z ∂(μ k) - ∫ z, f z ∂(ν k)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  intro N n O g μ ν C hO hC hgsupp hdense hμ hν hconv f hf
  set A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n) := O ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)) with hA
  set C₀ : ℝ := C.toReal with hC₀
  have hC₀nn : 0 ≤ C₀ := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hintegr : ∀ (μ' : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n))
      (h : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ)),
      μ' A ≤ C → tsupport h ⊆ A → Integrable (fun z ↦ h z) μ' := by
    intro μ' h hμ' hh
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := h.hasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous h.continuous
    have hOn : IntegrableOn (fun z ↦ h z) A μ' :=
      Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M) (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hC hμ')
        h.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall hM)
    exact (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ((subset_tsupport _).trans hh)).mp hOn
  have hest : ∀ (μ' : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n))
      (h : Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n → ℝ) (η : ℝ),
      0 ≤ η → μ' A ≤ C → (∀ z, z ∉ A → h z = 0) → (∀ z, |h z| ≤ η) → |∫ z, h z ∂μ'| ≤ η * C₀ := by
    intro μ' h η hηnn hμ' h0 hη
    rw [← setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero h0]
    have hlt : μ' A < ∞ := lt_of_le_of_lt hμ' (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hC)
    have h1 := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := μ') (s := A) (f := h) (C := η) hlt
      (fun z _ ↦ by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hη z)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    refine h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hηnn)
    exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hC hμ'
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  set η : ℝ := ε / (4 * (C₀ + 1)) with hηdef
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by positivity
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdense f hf η hηpos
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (hconv m) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hμ
  obtain ⟨K₃, hK₃⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hν
  refine ⟨max K₁ (max K₂ K₃), fun k hk ↦ ?_⟩
  have hk1 : K₁ ≤ k := le_of_max_le_left hk
  have hk2 : K₂ ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_of_max_le_right hk)
  have hk3 : K₃ ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_of_max_le_right hk)
  have hμk := hK₂ k hk2
  have hνk := hK₃ k hk3
  have hgk := hK₁ k hk1
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hgk ⊢
  have hfμ := hintegr (μ k) f hμk hf
  have hgμ := hintegr (μ k) (g m) hμk (hgsupp m)
  have hfν := hintegr (ν k) f hνk hf
  have hgν := hintegr (ν k) (g m) hνk (hgsupp m)
  have h0 : ∀ z, z ∉ A → f z - g m z = 0 := by

  have e2 := hest (ν k) (fun z ↦ f z - g m z) η hηpos.le hνk h0 hm

  rw [integral_sub hfν hgν] at e2

    have h4 : 0 < C₀ + 1 := by linarith
    have hrw : η * C₀ = ε / 4 * (C₀ / (C₀ + 1)) := by

    rw [hrw]; nlinarith

  have a2 := abs_le.mp e2

  constructor <;> linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2, a3.1, a3.2]
